Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /tmp/vhl_e2e_workspace_qpj1eq5t/bms-project_c15be6d9/communication-bridge/communication-bridge.scud:
     1	# communication-bridge.scud
     2	
     3	## 1. Module Overview & System Context
     4	The **communication-bridge** module serves as the critical translation layer between the low-voltage Microcontroller (LV domain) and the high-voltage isolated daisy chain (HV domain) used for battery monitoring. 
     5	
     6	**Primary Function:**
     7	- Translates Host UART or SPI signals into differential isolated signals for the BQ79616/BQ79612 monitor ICs.
     8	- Provides a "Wake-up" signal (INH) to activate the rest of the BMS stack.
     9	- Reports system-level faults via the NFAULT line.
    10	
    11	**External Interfaces:**
    12	- **Host Interface:** Connects to the Microcontroller Module via UART/SPI.
    13	- **Daisy Chain Interface:** Isolated differential pairs (COMHP/N, COMLP/N) connecting to the BMS Monitor Modules.
    14	- **Power:** Consumes 12V (BAT) and 3.3V/5V (VIO) from the Low-Voltage Power Supply.
    15	
    16	## 2. Architectural Deviations (Baseline vs. Target)
    17	The design is based on the BQ79600-Q1 Evaluation Module (EVM) but optimized for the stackable-bms system.
    18	
    19	**Removed components/blocks:**
    20	- **Evaluation Headers:** All development-specific headers (J2, J4, J7, J8, J9, J10, J11, J12, J13) and test points (TP1-TP17) are removed.
    21	- **Redundant Isolation Options:** Capacitor isolation path is removed in favor of **Transformer Isolation** (HMU1228NL) for 1000V DC rated isolation.
    22	- **Selection Jumpers:** Replaced with resistor straps for interface mode selection.
    23	
    24	**Added/Modified components/blocks:**
    25	- **Host Interface Protection:** Added TVS diode arrays on SCLK, nCS, MOSI, MISO, and NFAULT lines for ESD protection.
    26	- **Pull-up Resistors:** Added 10k Ohm pull-up on NFAULT (open-drain output).
    27	- **Mode Selection:** Added 10k Ohm pull-up/down option on nUART/SPI pin to select between SPI (Default: Pull-high) and UART.
    28	
    29	## 3. Components Inventory
    30	Based on the BQ79600-Q1 EVM and synthesized requirements:
    31	
    32	| Component | RefDes (Baseline) | Value/Part Number | Description |
    33	|:---|:---|:---|:---|
    34	| ASIC | U1 | BQ79600-Q1 | SPI/UART to Isolated Daisy Chain Bridge (TSSOP-16) |
    35	| Isolation Transformer | T1, T2 | HMU1228NL | Dual-channel isolation transformer for COM lines |
    36	| Decoupling Capacitor | C1 | 100nF, 50V | BAT (Pin 15) decoupling |
    37	| Decoupling Capacitor | C2 | 470nF, 10V | CVDD (Pin 14) decoupling |
    38	| Decoupling Capacitor | C3 | 470nF, 10V | DVDD (Pin 1) decoupling |
    39	| Decoupling Capacitor | C4 | 0.1uF, 10V | VIO (Pin 3) decoupling |
    40	| Termination Resistor | R23, R33, R24, R34 | 51 Ohm, 1% | Differential termination for COML and COMH |
    41	| Biasing Resistor | R27, R28, R29, R30 | 499 Ohm, 1% | Center-tap biasing for COM lines |
    42	| Bias Filter Capacitor | C5, C6 | 10nF, 50V | Decoupling for COM center-tap |
    43	| Filter Capacitor | C9, C10, C11, C12 | 100pF, 100V | Common-mode filter for isolated COM lines |
    44	| INH Series Resistor | R1 | 10 Ohm | Series protection for INH (Pin 16) |
    45	| Status LED | D2 | Green | CVDD (5V) Power indicator |
    46	| Status LED | D3 | Red | NFAULT active indicator |
    47	| LED Resistor | R5, R11 | 200 Ohm | Current limiter for D2 and D3 |
    48	| Pull-up Resistor | R_PU1 | 10k Ohm | NFAULT pull-up to VIO |
    49	| Mode Strap | R_STRAP | 10k Ohm | nUART/SPI mode selection (Pull-high for SPI) |
    50	| ESD Protection | D_ESD1, D_ESD2 | TVS Array | ESD protection for host IO pins |
    51	
    52	## 4. Connectivity & Signal Flow
    53	- **Power Architecture:** 
    54	    - **BAT (P2.1 -> Pin 15):** Main 12V supply. Buffered by C1.
    55	    - **VIO (P2.2 -> Pin 3):** IO supply (3.3V or 5V). Buffered by C4.
    56	    - **DVDD (P2.11 -> Pin 1):** 1.8V internal logic rail. Stabilized by C3.
    57	    - **CVDD (P1.3 -> Pin 14):** 5V communication rail. Stabilized by C2. Powers the daisy chain drivers.
    58	- **Host Interface (Cold Side):**
    59	    - **SCLK (P2.4 -> Pin 6)**, **nCS (P2.5 -> Pin 7)**, **MOSI/RX (P2.6 -> Pin 4)**, **MISO/TX (P2.7 -> Pin 5)**.
    60	    - **nUART/SPI (P2.8 -> Pin 8):** Strapped high for SPI mode. Functions as SPI_RDY output.
    61	    - **NFAULT (P2.9 -> Pin 2):** Active-low fault indicator. Pulled up to VIO.
    62	    - **INH (P2.10 -> Pin 16):** High-voltage wake-up output.
    63	- **Daisy Chain Interface (Hot Side):**
    64	    - **COMH (Pins 13, 12):** High-side differential pair. Connects to T2.
    65	    - **COML (Pins 10, 11):** Low-side (ring) differential pair. Connects to T1.
    66	    - Both pairs are terminated with 102 Ohm differential (2x 51 Ohm) and biased to ground via 499 Ohm center-taps.
    67	    - **Isolated Outputs (P1.1, P1.2):** Derived from the secondary side of transformers T1 and T2.
    68	
    69	## 5. Uncertainties, Assumptions & Confidence
    70	- **Isolation Method:** Selected Transformer isolation (HMU1228NL) to meet the 1000V DC system boundary requirement.
    71	- **Interface Selection:** Configured for SPI mode by default as per common high-speed MCU-BMS integration.
    72	- **INH Circuitry:** Provided as a direct pin output with series protection, assuming the receiving PMIC/regulator handles the logic levels.
    73	- **Confidence:** High for core ASIC functionality and signal mapping.
    74
